Types of saree drapes every woman should know!
Nivi. The classic. Pleats in front, pallu over the left shoulder.
Gujarati. The pallu comes over the right shoulder, to the front.
Nauvari. A nine-yard Maharashtrian drape, tucked like a dhoti.
Kerala. Cream and gold. Simple and graceful.
Coorgi. Pleats at the back, pallu tied over the shoulder.
Butterfly. A thin pallu that shows off the waist.
Lehenga style. Pleats all around, like a lehenga.
Pant style. Draped over pants. Modern and easy.
Mumtaz. Wrapped tight, with a short pallu. Pure retro Bollywood!
And the queen of drapes... the Bengali! Box pleats, and keys at the waist.
